Engine composition details below are proposed implementation inference, not official rulings

implementation.mutao: A genuine zero-card one-living-role activation once per actual Play. Freeze the entire true Hand set whose current continuous identity is a Slash variant; optional view-as opportunities are excluded. One native atomic move stages exact printed entities in a holder-owned public temporary source. Each gift reserves an ordered eligible original roster, native PRNG before/after/index and next living recipient before moving. Real gain and movement children finish between gifts. The final current effective Hand Slash count is frozen after the last gain subtree, capped at2; native damage source is the original selected holder, including self-source/target.
implementation.yimou: Every true after-damage occurrence freezes directional BaoXin-to-victim distance on the original native DamageTriggerWindowFrame, before earlier candidates may remove horses. Self0 is included and damage2 remains one opportunity. Issuer chooses obtain or gift. Obtain searches only actual printed Slash-family DrawPile entities, selects one with native replayed RNG and performs a true obtain rather than Draw1. For gift, the living victim privately chooses both its actual transferable Hand entity and another living recipient. Its true gift children finish before the victim receives one actual native Draw1, including a real reshuffle if needed.
implementation.ownership: All pending stages, original material sets, random reservation, victim/source/hash and collection-time damage facts live on their owning ProgramSkillFrame or native DamageTriggerWindowFrame. Nested collections defensively freeze. New event facts are scalar. No parallel pending resolver or use-ID sidecar is added.
implementation.privacy: Original staged material is genuinely public in its holder character area. Unstaged Hand cards remain private. Yimou recipient Hand selection belongs only to the actual victim, including an AI victim advanced through real native AI commands. Search rosters remain trusted diagnostics and are not a public deck view.
implementation.nativeChildren: Issued exact-source rights continue through genuine source-loss/death children. Native parent, original physical movement invoice, public temporary source lease, random reservation and once-paid return are verified at every resume. No direct Equipment removal/recovery producer exists in these costs, so no unrelated RecoveryParent exception is introduced.

inferences: The guide permits a no-Slash initial holder as no-op; accepting that genuine activation consumes its ordinary per-Play allowance. No extra nonempty-Hand/Slash target gate is invented.

Initial material identity and final count use the existing native continuous Hand identity query, preserving prior true renaming such as Fuman while excluding optional conversions. Once a renamed printed non-Slash leaves that Hand it remains its actual printed physical entity.

Seat traversal is recomputed between delivered cards over living participants. The random entity and next recipient of each individual issued gift are frozen before the move; later child windows cannot reroll or repay it.

Unavailable original materials retire only with a genuine departure from the exact temporary pile. New cards never substitute. Already delivered cards remain consumed if a child returns them; an exact final cleanup removes only original residue, never redistributes it.

Native holder death still moves its real registered public pile cards through death cleanup. The temporary registry lease merely preserves exact ownership until its owning continuation can retire/finish them; it does not protect cards from real death cleanup.

If issuer dies while a foreign holder remains alive, the paid ring continues if the native game has not ended. Final damage retains the original selected holder, including a valid dead source seat if the native sequence reaches that situation; no dedicated official FAQ establishes that composition.

Branch selection is an issued Yimou right. A dead actual victim receives no impossible later private choice or draw. Empty deck Slash stock causes no obtained card, no discard-pile fallback, no shuffle and no substituted draw.

The official distance1-or-less text controls over the guide shorthand distance1. Collection-time distance freezing across earlier after-damage horse-removal children is a native timing composition, not a claimed exclusive FAQ.
